subject: english
stem: Students should label shared chargers. Last month, three were taken to the wrong rooms. How does the number support the proposal?
options: It shows a recurring identification problem.
It shows chargers cannot be shared.
It proves three rooms have no power.

optionRationales.reason: It shows a recurring identification problem.：三次誤拿說明需要 label。
It shows chargers cannot be shared.：label 仍允許共享。
It proves three rooms have no power.：未提。
It supports removing every charger.：不是 proposal。

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「可爭論的主張由 because、since 或具體理由支撐，背景事實不一定是作者立場」可推出 It shows a recurring identification problem.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 It shows a recurring identification problem. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
